legalName: Erasure of an Adult Misdemeanor Conviction for Conduct Before Age 18, C.G.S. § 54-142a(f)
routeSelectionNote: The two branches are alternatives selected by the offense date, a fact on the participant's own record, so neither is selected for them and the worksheet carries no election control — it asks for the date and explains both branches, with the petition branch printed as a stop-and-get-help condition.

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether you were under 18 when the offense happened - this route exists only if you were
